query: SELECT pa.id, pa.acordoId, pa.nossoNumero, pa.status, pa.statusRemessa, pa.amount, pa.dueDate, a.devedorId, d.name as devedorNome FROM parcelasAcordo pa JOIN acordos a ON pa.acordoId = a.id LEFT JOIN devedores d ON a.devedorId = d.id WHERE pa.nossoNumero IN ('1000000084', '1000000085') ORDER BY pa.id;
